Third-party browser libraries bundled with the Mantis site (offline use).

- turndown.js: Turndown 7.2.4, MIT licence, https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown
- turndown-plugin-gfm.js: turndown-plugin-gfm 1.0.2, MIT licence, https://github.com/mixmark-io/turndown-plugin-gfm

Used only by the page editor (HTML back to Markdown). Loaded when Edit is clicked.
